property.name: icon
property.description-key: Default MDL2 icon name shown on every tile (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/apps/design/style/segoe-fluent-icons-font), or a JSON map of choice value to icon, e.g. {"1":{"icon":"Accept"}}

property.name: useExternalValueForIcon
property.description-key: When enabled, the External Value of each choice option is used as its icon name instead

property.name: hideHiddenOptions
property.description-key: Hide options marked as hidden in the option set

value.name: Value
value.description-key: Sort by the value of the options

value.name: Text
value.description-key: Sort by the text of the options, corresponding to the user language

property.name: tileShape
property.description-key: The corner shape of each tile

value.name: Square
value.description-key: Sharp corners

value.name: Rounded
value.description-key: Square with rounded corners

property.name: tileSize
property.description-key: Overall size of each tile (padding, min/max width, and label text size). The icon itself stays a fixed size regardless of this setting

value.name: Small
value.description-key: Smaller, more compact tiles

value.name: Normal
value.description-key: Standard tile size (default)

value.name: Large
value.description-key: Larger tiles

property.name: showChoiceValue
property.description-key: Show the choice options text label under the icon. When off, the label is hidden and the icon is shown larger, centered in the tile

property.name: makeFontBold
property.description-key: Display the tile label in bold font weight

property.name: notSelectedColor
property.description-key: Background color of a tile that is not selected (hex, e.g. #FFFFFF)

property.name: hoverColor
property.description-key: Background color of a tile while hovered (hex, e.g. #DEECF9)

property.name: selectedBackgroundMode
property.description-key: Whether the selected tiles background uses a custom color or the choice options own color

value.name: CustomColor
value.description-key: Use the Selected color property

value.name: ChoiceColor
value.description-key: Use the options own configured color

value.name: CustomColorFaded
value.description-key: Use a lighter, faded version of the choice options own configured color

property.name: selectedColor
property.description-key: Background color of the selected tile when Selected background mode is Custom color (hex, e.g. #F3F2F1)

property.name: selectedBorderMode
property.description-key: Whether the selected tile shows a border, and whether it uses a custom color or the choice options own color

value.name: Off
value.description-key: No border on the selected tile

value.name: CustomColor
value.description-key: Use the Selected border color property

value.name: ChoiceColor
value.description-key: Use the options own configured color

value.name: CustomColorFaded
value.description-key: Use a lighter, faded version of the choice options own configured color

property.name: selectedBorderColor
property.description-key: Border color of the selected tile when Selected border mode is Custom color (hex, e.g. #0078D4)

property.name: iconColorMode
property.description-key: How the tiles icon color is determined: automatic contrast against the tiles background (default), a fixed color, the choice options own color, or a faded version of the choice options own color

value.name: Auto
value.description-key: Icon color automatically matches the tiles background for contrast

value.name: CustomColor
value.description-key: Use the Icon color property

value.name: ChoiceColor
value.description-key: Use the options own configured color

value.name: CustomColorFaded
value.description-key: Use a lighter, faded version of the choice options own configured color

property.name: iconColor
property.description-key: Icon color used when Icon color mode is Fixed color (hex, e.g. #201F1E)

property.name: iconColorScope
property.description-key: Whether Icon color mode is applied to every tiles icon, or only the selected tiles icon (other tiles then use automatic contrast)

value.name: AllTiles
value.description-key: Apply Icon color mode to every tiles icon

value.name: SelectedOnly
value.description-key: Apply Icon color mode only to the selected tiles icon; other tiles use automatic contrast
